rows.Title: Bid approval overdue — 100+ days
rows.What Happened: Bid DEMO-B-2901 ($685) for a lockset + boarding job was submitted 12 Nov 2025 and is still Pending. The work order is In Progress and the crew is waiting on approval to proceed.
rows.Where to Look (exact IDs): Work Order DEMO-WO-1901 · Property DEMO-P-042 · Bid DEMO-B-2901 · Client CL-02 Prairie State Asset Group · Crew DEMO-C-04 Priya Nair
rows.What \"Solved\" Looks Like: The bid has a decision (Approved, Cut, or Rejected) recorded in Bids, with a Date Decided. If approved, the WO proceeds; if cut, the crew is told the approved amount.

rows.Title: Invoice unpaid 82 days past due
rows.What Happened: Invoice DEMO-INV-3901 ($1,150, debris removal) was due 8 Dec 2025 and has $0 received. No payment, no dispute, no note.
rows.Where to Look (exact IDs): Invoice DEMO-INV-3901 · WO DEMO-WO-1902 · Property DEMO-P-017 · Client CL-01 Heartland National Servicing · Bid DEMO-B-2902
rows.What \"Solved\" Looks Like: The client is contacted, a payment date is agreed and the follow-up recorded; or a dispute/deduction reason is recorded with evidence. The invoice status changes only when money arrives.

rows.Title: Looks unpaid — but it was paid under a follow-up WO
rows.What Happened: Invoice DEMO-INV-3902 ($240, grass cut) shows $0 received and looks overdue. But the same property got a follow-up grass WO DEMO-WO-1904, and the client paid $260 under THAT invoice (DEMO-INV-3903, paid 20 Sep 2025).
rows.Where to Look (exact IDs): WO DEMO-WO-1903 (old) → WO DEMO-WO-1904 (successor) · Property DEMO-P-058 · Invoices DEMO-INV-3902 and DEMO-INV-3903 · Client CL-03 Riverbend Property Partners
rows.What \"Solved\" Looks Like: The two WOs are linked as a chain (successor recorded), DEMO-INV-3902 is reclassified as paid-via-successor, and nobody chases the client for money already paid.

rows.Title: One crew, two jobs, same day
rows.What Happened: Crew DEMO-C-07 Rachel Boone is assigned two different jobs on 16 Sep 2025 — an inspection at DEMO-P-023 and a secure at DEMO-P-077. She cannot do both.
rows.Where to Look (exact IDs): Crew DEMO-C-07 Rachel Boone · WO DEMO-WO-1905 (DEMO-P-023) · WO DEMO-WO-1906 (DEMO-P-077) · both assigned 2025-09-16
rows.What \"Solved\" Looks Like: One job is reassigned to another crew member (Crew ID changed on the WO) or rescheduled to another day. No crew has two jobs on the same day after the fix.

rows.Title: Winterization closed with no pressure-test photo
rows.What Happened: WO DEMO-WO-1907 (full winterization) is Closed and its bid is approved, but the pressure-test photo is Missing. The photo gate says: no proof, no invoice — and indeed no invoice exists yet.
rows.Where to Look (exact IDs): WO DEMO-WO-1907 · Property DEMO-P-073 · Client CL-04 Meridian Bank REO Services · Crew DEMO-C-02 Dana Whitfield · Bid DEMO-B-2905 ($520 approved)
rows.What \"Solved\" Looks Like: The crew returns (or sends the photo from the visit) and the pressure-test photo is filed; only then is the invoice created. If the test was never done, the winterization is redone.

rows.Title: Bid $550 above the client ceiling
rows.What Happened: Bid DEMO-B-2906 prices an eviction cleanout at $1,450, but the client's ceiling for this job is $900. Submitting it as-is guarantees a cut or a rejection.
rows.Where to Look (exact IDs): Bid DEMO-B-2906 · WO DEMO-WO-1908 · Property DEMO-P-091 · Client CL-05 Cornerstone Home Investors · Ceiling $900
rows.What \"Solved\" Looks Like: The bid is repriced to $900 or below, or a written exception from the client is filed with the bid. The bid is never submitted above ceiling without that exception.
